title: Whether to test a staff-updated service-status concept
context: The concept is plausible but the user need and operational update burden are unverified.

options.description: Run limited user/staff discovery and a low-fidelity prototype test before committing to the MVP.
advantages: Tests the highest-risk user and operational assumptions before building.
disadvantages: Requires access to relevant participants and appropriate consent.
options.constraints_fit: Consistent with the fictional time-boxed challenge if a small exploratory test is feasible.

options.description: Build the status display immediately without further user evidence.
advantages: Fastest path to a clickable demo.
disadvantages: Risks solving a low-priority or misunderstood problem.
options.constraints_fit: Technically easy in the synthetic scenario but weak on evidence.

rationale: Peanuts recommends testing first, but this remains a proposal pending the owner's decision.

evidence_refs.note: The key user-need assumption is untested.

consequences: The PRD remains provisional until validation or an explicit decision to accept the risk.
revisit_trigger: Revisit after relevant student/staff discovery or if participant access is unavailable.
